the antibody responses elicitation in HIV-1 infected Indian children is similar to that in HIV-1 adults.

antibodies to V3 and IDL are present in the majority of HIV-1-infed children and that these antibody titers are higher in symptomatic patients.
the antibody titers against the immunogenic regions are significantly lower in ART treated patients, irrespective of their virological status.

The main takeaway from our work is that
antibodies to the viral envelope can be detected in HIV-1 infected children, and their levels are significantly lower in ART-treated children.
antibodies against V3 and IDL regions are found in the majority of HIV-1-inflected children, whereas antibodies against MPER are found in a smaller subset.
the humoral antibody response to the viral envelope in children is significantly lower compared to adults.
